description: One site's questions (up to 10) and, for each, the result from each AI in the latest check (named with the address, named, address given but not named, not named), how many AIs named the site on each of the last 7 checks, and who was named instead. Use it for "which of my questions did ChatGPT name me for?" or "which questions is Linktree winning?". For an AI's exact words on one question, use ai_answer.

site.description: Which of your sites: its domain ("biotree.bio"), its id from list_my_sites ("biotree-bio") or its name. Leave it out when the person has one site.

name: questions

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the person.

questions.description: { promptId, question, results: { chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity }, namedBy, last7, namedInstead }.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" for a question back, a plain no, or nothing there yet (see message).
